intent: A narrow, process-wide hook so an embedding application can observe JSON parse/serialize timing and document size, without the JSON package depending on that application.

objects.name: setMetricsObserver
objects.role: installs/replaces the callback; nullptr disables reporting

objects.name: reportMetrics
objects.role: invoked by Parser/Writer after each operation to notify the observer, if set

objects.name: (anonymous namespace) metricsObserver
objects.role: atomic<MetricsObserver> backing storage; not declared in the header
